name: utmail
systemHint: You have read-only UofT Outlook access through `utmail` (alias `uoftmail`, source at <exocortex-source-dir>/external-tools/utmail). Run `utmail -h`; prefer bounded reads and --json. Auth uses this machine's local vimbrowser. `utmail login --from-vimbrowser --tab ID` imports one exact signed-in Outlook tab; --persistent uses a separate renewable context. Never print bearer tokens/cookies. This tool cannot send/delete email. Per-machine state paths, and whether this machine runs the new-mail notifier, come from the tool's untracked config/local.env.
